overall: MARGINAL: calm on the Coron/Culion side and at Panlaitan, windy on the east side, strong current at Tara and Turda
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination: east wind at Nangalao, Ciron, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Barangonan (11–14 kt now, 15–16 kt this morning, 17–19.6 kt overnight into Thursday), and current at Tara and Turda (0.8–1.0 kt most of the day). Rain is minor: Barangonan 0.7 mm/h until about 8 AM, a few drops on the Coron side late morning and mid-afternoon, and light showers 0.1–0.4 mm/h at Tara, Decabobo and Turda about 6 PM–5 AM. Wednesday is mostly dry overall.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Friday is now the calmest day of the week, so Sat 7 supply improves from NEAR NORMAL to NORMAL. Friday reads 8.0 kt, gusts 13, dry (was 9.2 kt, gusts 15). Saturday has dried out (10 kt, gusts 17, no rain; was gusts 18 with 1.8 mm), so Sun 8 eases from SLIGHTLY SOFT to NEAR NORMAL. Wednesday is also lighter and dry (11 kt, gusts 16; was 12 kt, gusts 18, 2.8 mm).

Grounds improved to 8 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 2 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (yesterday 6 / 8 / 2): Linapacan and Binudac moved up to GOOD. The watch-out is a stronger east wind tonight: 17–19.6 kt from about 10 PM Wednesday to 5 AM Thursday at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron, Nangalao and Barangonan, so Fri 6 stays NEAR NORMAL but leans softer. Today Wed 4 and Thu 5 stay SLIGHTLY SOFT. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Wed–Tue (guide only; it reacts to the 0.5–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk eases to low to moderate: two soft arrival days (Wed 4 and Thu 5) are still ahead, but Friday's calm now gives a proper rebound on Sat 7. Lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for Thursday–Friday supply.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 1 PM, west and central grounds
details: Panlaitan and Maglalambay: under 8.5 kt until about 1 PM (near calm about 10 AM–noon) and again under 8 kt from about 11 PM, current 0.1–0.3. Coron and Galoc: under 6 kt until about 10 AM and again from about 10 PM, current 0.1–0.4; Culion the same wind with current 0.5–0.6 from about 1 PM. Decabobo: under 9 kt and 0.2–0.5 kt all 24h. Linapacan: 8–10 kt until about 9 AM and again about 3–9 PM. East side: only the afternoon lull, about 2–6 PM (11.5–13 kt, current 0.3–0.5).
Keep small boats off Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron, Nangalao and Barangonan from about 10 PM tonight to 5 AM Thursday (17–19.6 kt), and off Tara and Turda most of the day (0.8–1.0 kt current).
